max_sales: URGENT — BeaconBank POC warmup is hitting 429s on /v1/checkout right before the exec demo (20m). Browser shows "429 Too Many Requests". They started ~50 parallel tabs during smoke.

rachel_se: Tenant and sample req? Any rate-limit headers?

max_sales: tenant=beaconbank-poc, req=req_bb_a9. Headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 Retry-After:3 X-RateLimit-Limit:120/min.

ben_engineer: Sounds like tenant bucket exhaustion. Short-term options: (1) temporary burst override for demo, (2) route demo to smaller model to reduce token cost, (3) throttle at CDN. Ops, can you apply a 20m burst if SE approves?

ops_oncall: I can run `POST /internal/admin/tenants/beaconbank-poc/burst {"minutes":20,"qps":400}`. Need SE/eng ack. cluster-alpha free_nodes=1.

rachel_se: Ack, please apply. Also prepare a client snippet: max concurrency=8 + exponential backoff with jitter. Sending snippet after this.

infra_bot: [autoscaler] cluster-alpha free_nodes=1 last_deploy=stable@2026-12-10T09:12Z

ops_oncall: Burst applied for 20m. Ticket OPS-1342. Watching ingress for req_bb_a9.

ben_engineer: Tailing logs — gateway shows bucket empty then success after burst:
```
[INGRESS] 2026-12-10T09:08:12Z tenant=beaconbank-poc req=req_bb_a9 route=/v1/checkout status=429 concurrent=52
[INGRESS] 2026-12-10T09:08:13Z tenant=beaconbank-poc req=req_bb_a9 route=/v1/checkout status=200 lat_ms=142
```

max_sales: Demo resumed, execs completed the checkout demo. They asked about guaranteed capacity for payroll spikes and enterprise pricing.

maya_security: Also they want confirmation on card tokenization and PCI scope — I'll open a dedicated security thread and request flow diagram + questionnaire.

rachel_se: Next steps: (1) offer Dedicated trial or Reserved QPS (propose 1k sustained with burst buffer), (2) publish client backoff snippet in playbook, (3) add one-click demo burst in Console with audit log, (4) follow up on PCI questionnaire in security thread.

ops_oncall: Burst will auto-revoke at T+20m. OPS-1342 open for quota review and follow-up.

max_sales: Thank you team — scheduling post-demo pricing + security call. Closing this thread. :thumbsup:
